meta.title: eventmem memory
meta.description: Shared event memory with recall, seven tools, turn-end extraction and the memory console under Plugins in the sidebar. This bundle is only a client: install and start the eventmem daemon separately. Its API and console have no built-in authentication; keep them private. Extraction can make an additional host-model request. If the daemon is unreachable, automatic memory is skipped rather than blocking the turn.
